alt: Real ChatGPT /peerassessment execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /peerassessment Using only the attached chapter, build an interactive peer-assessment rubric for training, inference and context. Include 0/1/2 scores, feedback fields, expected evidence and a total. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Enter fictional names for a demonstration assessment.
Assign two points to the training criterion.
Write specific feedback about parameter updates.
Reveal the chapter evidence for the training criterion.
Assign one point to the incomplete inference explanation.
Write an actionable improvement for the inference criterion.
Reveal expected evidence about ordinary inference.
Assign two points to the context and retrieval criterion.
Write feedback on retrieval and source checking.
Reveal the chapter evidence about context and retrieval.
Write an overall strength and a concrete improvement.
Inspect the finalized scores and written feedback.
Reset the rubric and return to the unscored progress.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
